products.name: ServiceNow Now Assist
products.note: ITSM/HRSD embedded AI; workflow automation; enterprise process governance

reading.body:
ServiceNow is a public, for-profit enterprise software company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with $13.28 billion in revenue for the fiscal year ending December 2025, competing in AI governance and business-application automation.

Its two recorded products sit at the workflow and compliance layer of the AI stack rather than at the model or infrastructure layer. AI Governance, built into the Now Platform and expanded in June 2026, handles model inventory, risk scoring, approval workflows, and cross-system observability. Now Assist embeds AI into IT service management and HR service delivery. Both products presuppose that AI is already deployed elsewhere and needs to be managed, not that ServiceNow is the source of the compute or the models.

The data records 161 points of California regulatory exposure, which is notable given the company's Santa Clara headquarters and the active pace of AI-related legislation in that state. Whether that exposure translates into product constraint, competitive advantage, or compliance cost is not something the data answers. The data also contains no information on ServiceNow's own infrastructure footprint, energy consumption, or data center strategy, so no connection to compute or power can be drawn from what is recorded here.
